summary: Chunghwa Telecom furnished a Form 6-K, the US foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a current report, solely to attach a press release dated 2026-11-04 disclosing unaudited third-quarter 2026 consolidated results under T-IFRSs. No transaction, shareholder action, board recommendation, or advisor is referenced. Reported figures include total revenue up 16.7% to NT$67.59 billion, operating income up 27.1% to NT$15.38 billion, net income attributable to parent up 29.5% to NT$12.22 billion, and basic EPS of NT$1.57, all above the high end of quarterly guidance.
